text:
emily: quick report from onboarding QA: some customers saw raw request ids in logs when trying the quickstart with OTEL_AUTO enabled

rahul: which quickstart? node, python, go?

emily: multi-lang quickstart (node + python sidecars). Repro: start containers with OTEL_AUTO=true and hit /generate with header `x-request-id: clz_feedface001122`. The console shows the full id at INFO level.

kevin: i can repro on node. snippet (redacted):
```
INFO 2026-03-27T08:22:10Z incoming request req_id=clz_feedface001122 user=dev@example.com
DEBUG 2026-03-27T08:22:10Z otel: start span=... trace_id=abc123
INFO 2026-03-27T08:22:10Z dispatching req_id=clz_feedface001122 route=/generate
```

sophia: same pattern in python but slightly different ordering: otel logs appear before our middleware runs. it means our existing redaction middleware misses those early logs.

emily: QA found three variants across languages: 1) early otel log before redactor, 2) third-party retry libs adding new id fields with different casing, 3) structured JSON emit that gets buffered before app-level scrubbers run.

rahul: this is an SDK parity problem. Node had middleware-first behavior historically, python/go auto-instrumentation can run earlier. we need a consistent emitter-side sanitizer.

kevin: proposed short-term mitigations: flip onboarding images to OTEL_AUTO=false, set LOG_LEVEL=WARN for onboarding builds, and add smoke tests asserting no `clz_` pattern present in logs captured during quickstart e2e.

sophia: agreed. for structured logs we can't safely do a stdout regex scrub (it corrupts JSON). need SDK-level hooks.

emily: can we add a tiny transport-level sanitizer in SDKs that runs as the last step before emit (console, HTTP transport, Sentry)? call it `telemetry.addEmitterSanitizer` or similar.

rahul: API suggestion: `telemetry.registerEmitterSanitizer(sanitizeFn)` where sanitizeFn receives a string payload and returns a sanitized string. Language-agnostic and simple. SDKs can ship default sanitizer that redacts `clz_[0-9a-fA-F]{6,}` and common header names (req_id, requestId, x-request-id) in JSON by replacing values, not structural keys.

kevin: warp-speed notes: sanitizer needs to be careful with binary payloads and ensure idempotence. also allow order: multiple sanitizers can be registered, last registered runs last. provide a built-in default that can be disabled via config `redwood.telemetry.sanitize=false`.

sophia: plus we should add `post_instrumentation_hooks` to let apps opt to run a callback after auto-instrumentation so they can attach redaction middleware in the right place. but emitter sanitizer is the real guardrail.

emily: security asked to block public onboarding videos until images flipped or sanitizer deployed. security-bot: any comment?

security-bot: P1 flagged: onboarding artifacts leaking internal request ids. Recommend onboarding image change + SDK sanitizer patch before public assets are published.

rahul: plan of attack: 1) flip onboarding images (short PR) 2) add CI smoke tests to samples asserting no `clz_` pattern in both plain and json logs 3) ship emitter sanitizer in Node SDK first, mirror to Python/Go within 2 weeks 4) follow-up RFC to add post-instrumentation hook for parity.

kevin: i'll open the Node PR for `addEmitterSanitizer` with tests that simulate otel-first ordering and retry libs. Use default regexp `clz_[0-9a-fA-F]{6,}` and a list of canonical field names to scrub in JSON.

sophia: i'll handle the python sample patch to flip onboarding defaults and add a unit test. also will update docs: quickstart note about OTEL_AUTO and redaction until SDKs have sanitizer.

emily: quick snippet for smoke test suggestion:
```
# spin up sample with OTEL_AUTO=true
# curl /generate
# assert `grep -E "clz_[0-9a-fA-F]{6,}"` returns non-zero exit -> fail
```

rahul: CI should fail if any clz_ found at INFO level or in JSON payloads. add test runner that captures both stdout and structured log collector.

kevin: opened issue SDK-517: "emitter sanitizer for redaction parity" and draft PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/517 (WIP).

sophia: ping me on the PR, i'll add a python mirror after Node lands. also let's include a changelog entry for onboarding customers.

emily: thanks all. leaving thread open while PRs and image flip progress. i'll update once staging images pushed. :thumbsup:
